subject: Weighted average using plyr or reshape

messages.author: 95698948edb03b78
messages.subject: Weighted average using plyr or reshape
parts:
I have the following data

dn p1 p2 wp
3 50 80 1
5 75 90 1
7 0 100 1
2 30 20 2
5 25 5 2
8 10 10 2

and want to produce a weighted average of p1 and p2 using dn as weight
for wp=1 and wp=2. Both p's (periods) will be expanded and the no. of
wp's will also become larger. Output should look like this

wp p1 p2
1 35 92.67
2 17.67 19.67

I 've spent a lot of time trying to do this, but couldn't. Please
help.

Thanks,

Fritsander

messages.author: f03c91905cbdb6f9
messages.subject: Re: Weighted average using plyr or reshape
parts:
try this:

> x
dn p1 p2 wp
1 3 50 80 1
2 5 75 90 1
3 7 0 100 1
4 2 30 20 2
5 5 25 5 2
6 8 10 10 2
> do.call(rbind, lapply(split(x, x$wp), function(.wp){
+ wp1 <- sum(.wp$dn * .wp$p1) / sum(.wp$dn)
+ wp2 <- sum(.wp$dn * .wp$p2) / sum(.wp$dn)
+ c(wp=.wp$wp[1L], p1=wp1, p2=wp2)
+ }))
wp p1 p2
1 1 35.00000 92.666667
2 2 17.66667 9.666667
>
>

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Weighted average using plyr or reshape
parts:
Hi:

Try this:

wavg <- function(x, wt) x %*% wt/sum(wt)
wa1 <- ddply(dd, .(wp), transform, wp1 = wavg(p1, dn), wp2 = wavg(p2, dn))[, 4:6]
wa2 <- ddply(wa1, .(wp), head, n = 1)
names(wa2) <- c('wp', 'p1', 'p2')
> wa2

HTH,
Dennis

ddply(dd, .(wp), summarise, wp1 = wavg(p1, dn), wp2 = wavg(p2, dn))

Hadley

The dataset below (my previous message) is extending to for example the data inserted here
 
 dn  p1   p2  p3  p4  wp
3 50 80 40 35 1
5 75 90 30 25 1
7 0 100 20 60 1
2 30 20 45 50 2
5 25 5 75 20 2

How to adjust Hadley's code
ddply(dd, .(wp), summarise, wp1 = wavg(p1, dn), wp2 = wavg(p2, dn))

when using grouping for an increasing number of periods in an automated way.
 
Results should be a vector of weighted averages per period.
 
So far trying to use for loops didn't work at all.
 
Thanks in advance,
 
Fritsander

messages.subject: Re: Weighted average using plyr or reshape
parts:
Here it is:

The data

After loading the data I define the function to calculate the weighted
average

wavg <- function(x, wt) x %*% wt/sum(wt)

then

s<-match("p1",colnames(gew)) # determine the column index of the
first period (week)
f<-match("p4",colnames(gew)) # determine the column index of the
last period (week)
d<-s:f
t.val<-names(gew[d]) # put names of the dataframe into variable t.val
to be used to feed into reshape below

gews<-reshape(gew, times=t.val,timevar="Week",v.names="PC",
varying=list(d), direction="long") # reshape the data to the long
format

now plyr can determine the weighted averages for every period using
the statement Hadley provided

wa<-ddply(gews, .(Week), summarise, wavg(PC, dn))

then I change the names of the columns in the resulting dataframe

names(wa)=c("Week","PC")

Done!

The only thing that still needs to be done manually is to change the
period name to the next week every week in the statement above to
determine the column index of the last period (week) to be fed into
the rest of the script.

You're welcome.

Kind regards,

Fritsander
